description: Graph paths treated as customer-content for Test-CIPPGraphEndpointBlocked. Case-insensitive regexes against the percent-decoded path (host/version stripped) and against $expand values. Segments end at /, (, ;, : or end of path so OData key syntax like messages('id') is covered.
